scope: Proposition 3.4 (Adjoint addition) of the manuscript “Orbifold and logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity” (preprints/Orbifold-and-logarithmic-Iitaka-subadditivity-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 033 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b143366cc99615e1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 19. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let h : W → Y be a fibration between smooth compact manifolds in class C. Let T, C be rational SNC boundaries with C ≤ B(h, T), and suppose every prime of W whose image has codimension at least two in Y has coefficient one in T. Let p : W → S be a surjective morphism with connected fibers to a smooth projective variety. Suppose P is a nef rational line bundle on S, M = p∗P, and KS + a0P is big for some rational a0 > 0. If KW + T + M is big on very general h-fibers, then κ(W, KW + T + M) ≥ dim(W/Y ) + κ(Y, KY + C).
